    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    SCOUT is built on the conviction that recruitment fluency is a strategic capability — not a soft skill. Every module pairs business-English precision with human judgment, organizational literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium recruitment leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern recruitment — from the foundations of candidate screening and interview technique to AI-powered talent acquisition and virtual hiring.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — interview evaluations, offer negotiations, diversity initiatives, onboarding handoffs — written for international recruitment professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    B.G.
    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. SCOUT reflects his vision: recruitment fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and human credibility.

    Designed for the recruiters, talent leads, and hiring leaders shaping how organizations find and welcome new talent — SCOUT is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning a search into a genuine match.
